name: Pagination
summary: Named native page navigation with an ordered list, canonical destination links, one non-interactive current page, passive ellipses, boundary omission, and target-owned URLs and page windows.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named native navigation landmark for one bounded result set.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Native unordered list preserving destination order and grouping.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeatable native list item containing one link, current page, or ellipsis.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Canonical native Link for an available page, previous destination, or next destination.

anatomy.name: current
anatomy.description: Exactly one non-interactive current-page indicator when Pagination renders.

anatomy.name: ellipsis
anatomy.description: Passive skipped-range indicator hidden from assistive technology.

behavior.name: navigationLandmark
behavior.description: Pagination renders as a specifically named native navigation landmark.

behavior.name: orderedDestinations
behavior.description: One native list preserves page and directional destination order without a composite-widget role.

behavior.name: nativeLinks
behavior.description: Every available destination composes canonical Link with a real target-owned URL, native activation, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.

behavior.name: currentPage
behavior.description: Exactly one non-interactive item represents the current page; it is not a disabled pseudo-link.

behavior.name: boundaryOmission
behavior.description: Previous is omitted on the first page and next is omitted on the last page instead of leaving focusable aria-disabled anchors.

behavior.name: ellipsis
behavior.description: Ellipsis is passive, hidden from assistive technology, and never presented as a link.

behavior.name: targetOwnedLifecycle
behavior.description: The target owns total pages, page-window calculation, URLs, requests, result replacement, loading/error status, history, scroll, focus, announcements, analytics, and prefetch.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: The supplied finite item window wraps inside its container without CSS hiding, reordering, or viewport assumptions.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name for the pagination navigation.

properties.name: currentPage
properties.description: Positive current-page projection matching the one rendered aria-current item; it does not define total pages or a page-window algorithm.

properties.name: pageItems
properties.description: Finite target-supplied list of previous, page, current, ellipsis, and next items with real destination URLs.

accessibility: Render a specifically named navigation landmark containing a native list.
Use native anchors with href for every available destination and normal Tab and Enter behavior.
Mark exactly one non-interactive current page with aria-current="page".
Omit unavailable previous or next destinations instead of leaving CSS-disabled anchors in the tab order.
Hide passive ellipsis items from assistive technology and never make them interactive.
Give icon-only previous and next links localized accessible names and hide decorative icons.
Keep the semantic minimum destination target, visible focus ring, forced-color distinction, and wrap-safe localized content.
Leave result announcements, focus restoration, scrolling, pending/error state, history, and URL synchronization to one target coordinator.

shopify.notes: main-collection.liquid maps Shopify paginate parts, native URLs, localized labels, current state, ellipses, and boundary omission to the canonical anatomy.
